description: This file defines a set of API endpoints related to user profile management within a FastAPI web application. It includes routes for creating, retrieving, updating, searching, and deleting user profiles, leveraging SQLAlchemy for database interactions and JWT for authentication.

methods.name: create_user_profile( profile_data: UserProfileCreate = Body(...), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Creates a new user profile for the authenticated user, ensuring no duplicate exists.

methods.name: get_my_profile( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: update_my_profile( profile_update: UserProfileUpdate = Body(...), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Updates fields of the current user's profile based on provided data.

methods.name: get_profile_by_id( profile_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Fetches a user profile by its profile ID, respecting privacy settings.

methods.name: search_profiles( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query for display name or username"), favorite_sport: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by favorite sport"), location: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by location"), verified_only: bool = Query(False, description="Show only verified profiles"), limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of profiles to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of profiles to skip"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Searches for profiles matching filtering criteria, images visibility rules.

methods.name: delete_my_profile( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Deletes the profile of the current authenticated user.
